content.short: Jokerace is a decentralized on-chain contest platform enabling communities to run competitions and votes where token holders decide winners on Mantle.
content.description: Jokerace is a novel governance and contest platform that allows communities to run any type of competition or vote on-chain, with token holders determining the outcomes through their voting power. Projects can create contests for grant allocation, creative submissions, community polls, hackathon judging, and more  with all submissions and votes recorded transparently on-chain. Jokerace is deployed on Mantle, enabling Mantle ecosystem communities to run fair and transparent competitions governed by their token holders.
content.meta: Jokerace is an on-chain contest and community voting platform for Mantle ecosystem communities. Discover Jokerace on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
